messages:
clare: quick note from staging: model-X rollout produced an unexpected flood of tiny spans. p99 ingestion latency went up and queue depth spiked. we need a pragmatic mitigation path: aggressive edge sampling vs coalescing noisy signals + metering. thoughts?

jin: quick take: sampling buys headroom fast but kills fidelity for postmortems and model debugging.

nashwin: coalescing + metering keeps analytics intact but shifts CPU to gateways. main open: how to reliably attribute cost to tenants after coalescing?

marta: ops: coalescing changes traffic profile (fewer envelopes, heavier ones). that affects shard sizing. sampling keeps shapes stable.

clare: shortlist of constraints: debugability for regressions, accurate billing, bounded memory at the edge, and ability to backfill when rollback needed.

jin: propose hybrid: do a lightweight pre-sample (e.g., 40% keep) at gateway, compute a cheap fingerprint for noisy spans and keep a tiny per-tenant reservoir (TTL 5m, small cap). after enrichment, run a second-stage policy to resurrect important traces (errors, latency anomalies, anomaly-score).

nashwin: deterministic sampling should use stable keys (service_name + trace_root) because tenant info is often late. reconcile billing after enrichment.

marta: reservoir fairness: soft per-tenant quotas; eviction by LRU+priority (error > high-latency > random). expose knobs so SRE can adjust per-release.

clare: billing surface: when we coalesce N noisy spans into 1 aggregate we must still account for tokens/exec. emit two artifacts: (1) low-cardinality observation aggregate for tracing pipelines, (2) compact metering events with summed token counts and request counts that feed billing. mark metering as provisional until enrichment finalizes.

jin: sample metering event shape: {tenant_id, window_start, window_end, token_sum, request_count, provisional_flag} — small and idempotent-friendly. reconciliation job flips provisional->final after enrichment.

nashwin: reconciliation window tradeoff: choose ~1h to balance latency vs correctness. Console should show provisional badge until finalized.

marta: technical: fingerprinting must be cheap. normalize span name by stripping ids/literals (single-pass tokenizer) then hash. avoid heavy regex; wasm normalizer on gateway seems good. perf target <1us/span.

clare: config draft to try in staging: 

```
signal_mitigation_config {
  gateway_pre_sample: 0.4
  reservoir { per_tenant_limit: 80, ttl_seconds: 300 }
  attenuation { fingerprint_window_seconds: 60, keep_top_k_per_fingerprint: 2 }
  metering_window_seconds: 60
}
```

nashwin: guardrails: total reservoir memory cap, circuit-breaker if gateway memory exceeds threshold, metrics for eviction/resurrect counts, and a kill-switch feature flag.

marta: I'll POC a tiny wasm normalizer and measure CPU/latency impact on staging gateways. if it exceeds budget we'll move normalization to a lightweight sidecar.

clare: actions: ashwin -> prototype reservoir + backfill + dedupe semantics; jin -> draft metering proto + reconciliation job and provisional UI notes; marta -> wasm POC + perf numbers; clare -> coordinate follow-up sync.

ingest-bot: alert at 3771234610: staging-ingest queue latency spike correlated with model-X rollout.

jin: one more UX idea: provide an "expand traces" Console action that fetches raw traces from reservoir/backfill for a tight time window around an anomaly. rate-limit and ACL it.

nashwin: ensure expand uses dedupe by canonical trace_id + ingest_fingerprint and respects tenant ACLs.

marta: will attach wasm perf results and recommended config to my PR.

clare: thanks team. aim for conservative rollout of this mitigations set; we'll relax thresholds after we confirm stability. sync Fri to review POC results. :thumbsup:
